name: Lincoln City Libraries Teen Volunteer (VolunTEEN and Teen Advisory Board)
what_you_do: Teens sort and shelve materials. They pull materials for displays, help with bulletin boards and prepare supplies for the Summer Reading Challenge. They also help at special library events. Teens can give input on library collections, spaces and events.
who_can_apply: Anyone who has finished 5th grade and is under 19 (teen track). You also need approval from the City of Lincoln Human Resources Department.
duration: Teen Advisory Board: one meeting a month, August to May. VolunTEEN: 1 to 2 times a week during Summer Reading Challenge (May, June, July). School groups: 10 hours or more in a semester.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. The page says to ask the branch if it is taking new volunteers.
how_to_apply: Download and print the Minor Volunteer Application (under age 19). Fill it out. Then contact the Volunteer Coordinator at the library branch you want. Expect a 1 to 2 week wait before you hear back.
notes: Library address: 136 South 14th Street, Lincoln, NE 68508. Phone 402-441-8500. Branches may not be taking new volunteers, so call first. Tasks also listed for National Honor Society and Government and Politics students needing 10 hours.
